title: One Symptom, Three Levers: A Critical Review of On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2608.25936v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation trains a language model on its own generations while a teacher scores them token by token. It combines the dense supervision of imitation learning with the on-policy sampling of reinforcement learning. But it requires a second, larger model to act as teacher. On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) removes that cost. The teacher is the model itself, conditioned on privileged information the student will not have at test time, such as a reference solution, a plan, or environment feedback. The teacher is no stronger than the student, only better informed. Early results were promising, with accuracy comparable to reinforcement learning at a fraction of the generated tokens. But the same asymmetry that produces the signal also biases it. One failure mode now dominates the field: collapse, the progressive narrowing of the set of reasoning paths the model can produce. translated_title: 一个症状，三个杠杆：关于同策略自蒸馏的批判性综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25936v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：同策略蒸馏在教师模型逐词打分的同时，训练语言模型基于自身生成的内容进行学习。它结合了模仿学习的密集监督与强化学习的同策略采样，但需要第二个更大的模型作为教师。同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）消除了这一成本。教师即模型本身，基于学生测试时无法获得的特权信息（如参考解决方案、计划或环境反馈）进行条件化。教师并不比学生更强，只是信息更充分。早期结果令人鼓舞，在生成令牌数量仅为强化学习一小部分的情况下，准确率可与之媲美。但产生信号的同一不对称性也引入了偏差。如今，一个失败模式主导了该领域：崩溃，即模型能产生的推理路径集合逐渐收窄。崩溃并非OPSD特有，尽管特权信息加剧了这一问题。
tldr: 本文批判性综述了同策略自蒸馏（OPSD），指出其核心创新在于利用模型自身作为教师，通过特权信息提供密集监督，但该方法的根本局限是导致推理路径崩溃，并提出三个干预杠杆（症状、机制与设计）来应对这一挑战。
en_tdlr: This review critically examines on-policy self-distillation (OPSD), highlighting its innovation of using the model itself as a teacher with privileged information for dense supervision, while identifying reasoning-path collapse as the dominant failure mode and proposing three intervention levers to address it.
